intent_id.description: Unique identifier for the raw intent session

version.description: Version string of the intent (e.g. v1, v2)

status.description: Current state of the raw intent normalization lifecycle

raw_request.description: The exact original user prompt text as received

user_goal.description: Abstracted functional goal desired by the user

raw_product_intent.description: Product-only intent without Agent-directed workflow instructions

workflow_constraints.description: Delivery and verification policies kept outside raw_product_intent

excluded_from_raw_intent.description: Process statements intentionally excluded from product intent

intent_classification.description: Greenfield coverage class for downstream Blueprint generation

desired_outcomes.description: Expected observable outcomes or user-visible behaviors

actors.description: Target users or system components interacting with the feature

user_proposed_solutions.description: Mechanisms or technical solutions explicitly mentioned by the user

constraints.description: Explicit constraints (e.g. backward compatibility, performance limit)

preferences.description: User preferences that are not strict requirements

known_facts.description: Confirmed empirical facts from conversation or prompt

discoverable_facts.description: Facts discovered directly from the workspace repository without asking the user

assumptions.description: Safe working assumptions made by the system

out_of_scope_candidates.description: Items explicitly or implicitly out of scope for this request

referenced_artifacts.description: Files, issues, or blueprints referenced in the intent

repository_evidence.description: Relative paths to source code files or configs verified in workspace

risk_flags.description: Identified safety or destructive risk flags (8 types supported)

approval_signals.description: Detected approval or confirmation statements in conversation

clarification_rounds.description: Number of clarification Q&A turns executed

normalization_readiness.description: Readiness score for proceeding to Phase 05 (0-100)

content_hash.description: Content hash of this normalized intent JSON
